frozen: 2026-10-24, before sampling or downloading any holdout case
selection: IDC lidc_idri studies with one CT and >=1 SEG nodule group with >=2 readers (803 eligible); exclude the 8 previously used patients; random sample of 15 PatientIDs, numpy default_rng(20261024).choice(sorted ids, 15, replace=False)
pipeline: B1 series = the study's CT; B2 conversion (scripts/b2_convert.py logic); B3 detection bundle unchanged; reader masks via bench/lidc_seg_masks.py (referenced-SOP mapping); groups with >=2 readers; consensus/reference/diameter exactly as nodule-measure-v1
matching: best-scoring detector box within 10 mm of reader-consensus centroid (any score, same as vista-reliability-v1); unmatched groups = detection misses, reported, excluded from measurement metrics
method: A7 from nodule-measure-v1 (f=0.5, k=1.5, r=1 mm), unchanged code; C = box (w+h)/2; flag = A7 failed OR |A7 - C| > 2.0 mm
shifts: box centre 0 and +-3 mm per array axis (7 positions)
pass: all gates on the holdout set; scored once, no parameter changes after scoring
